_approach: Wikipedia's Dariacore entry names 'bouncy, syncopated rhythms derived from Jersey club' as one of the genre's core borrowings. This groove keeps the Jersey 5-kick shape (1, 2, 3, a-of-3, &-of-4) but pushes the tempo well past Jersey Club's own range and stacks a clap+snare hit for extra weight, the way dariacore treats an existing dance rhythm as raw material to accelerate and distort rather than a groove to preserve untouched. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
